title: Davis hired by CIA as WINPAC branch chief scientist

tellings.quote: I actually got hired by the CIA to be the branch chief science K scientist of winpack back in late 2003

plain: The scientist Eric W. Davis says the CIA hired him in late 2003 as a branch chief scientist at WINPAC, a CIA unit that deals with weapons threats. He tells Michels this about his own career, as part of his background in classified work.
